successCriteria.description: IBalanceService exposes getCurrentBalances(employeeId: string): Promise<Array<LeaveBalance & { available: number }>> and BalanceService implements it, returning a list (possibly []) where every entry carries leaveTypeCode, periodStart, periodEnd, entitledDays, usedDays, pendingDays and a computed available.

getCurrentBalances selects AT MOST ONE policy per leaveTypeCode: status ACTIVE (via LeavePolicyStatus imported from ../policy, never a bare 'ACTIVE' string), effectiveFrom <= asOf, effectiveTo null or >= asOf, tie-break latest effectiveFrom.

For each selected policy, getCurrentBalances computes the current accrual period via periodContaining(employee.hireDate, policy.accrualPeriodMonths, new Date()) imported from src/shared/date, and looks the balance up with repository.findByKey.
A leave type whose current period has no balance row is OMITTED (never throws, never synthesizes a row); when no leave type has a balance row the result is an empty list, not an error.
available is computed as entitledDays - usedDays - pendingDays for every returned entry.

The balance module exposes a route that resolves the actor from request.user (reusing the resolveActor/sendError shape from src/modules/leave/leave.routes.ts), calls getCurrentBalances(actor.id), and returns the list with a 200 status; the route is re-exported from src/modules/balance/index.ts and registered in src/app.ts.

constraints: Read-only: getCurrentBalances and its route must not open a transaction (no IUnitOfWork.withTransaction) and must not perform any writes.
No controller file: the route calls the service directly, matching the existing leave/auth route shape.
Use LeavePolicyStatus imported from ../policy (the policy module's public entry point), never a bare 'ACTIVE' string literal.
Import periodContaining from src/shared/date (Phase 1), not a local/private copy.
Actor identity comes from request.user (verified token); never a client-supplied id.
All database access goes through the repository (IBalanceRepository.findByKey); no inline SQL in the service or route.
outOfScope: No audit-log writes (GP-002) — this phase is read-only.
No balance writes: openPeriod/carryForward and any accrual/entitlement mutation are unchanged and out of scope.
No promotion of LeavePolicyStatus into src/shared/types — it stays module-local and is imported via ../policy.
No refactor of leave.service.ts/balance.service.ts private date helpers to import the shared helpers (deferred).
No leave-type catalog enumeration — balances are derived from policies, not the leave-type table.

entityInvariants.invariant: available is a computed, derived value (entitledDays - usedDays - pendingDays) — it is never persisted and never mutates the stored LeaveBalance row; the stored entity keeps exactly its 7 persisted fields.
Effective-policy selection yields at most one policy per leaveTypeCode for a given asOf: ACTIVE status, effectiveFrom <= asOf, effectiveTo null or >= asOf, tie-break latest effectiveFrom.
A leave type is represented in the result only when a balance row exists for the current accrual period (findByKey hit); absence of a row means omission, never a synthesized or thrown balance.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must be authenticated; the employeeId is the resolved actor's id (from the verified token), never client-supplied.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Read-only: returns [] when no balance rows exist; never throws for a missing balance row. Unknown employee surfaces NotFoundError (404) via employeeService.getEmployeeById.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Requires a valid bearer token; resolveActor validates presence + role membership at the API boundary (UnauthorizedError on missing/invalid actor).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Errors return { error, code }; AppError mapped to its status, any other throw to 500, matching the leave/auth sendError shape.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Reuse the resolveActor/sendError helper shape (actor resolution from request.user, AppError -> { error, code }, else 500) exactly as implemented in the leave routes.
Import periodContaining (and the accrual helpers) from the shared date entry point, not a local copy.
Import LeavePolicyStatus from the policy module's public entry point (never a bare 'ACTIVE' string).
Use the existing IBalanceRepository.findByKey(employeeId, leaveTypeCode, periodStart, periodEnd) signature for the balance lookup.
Use employeeService.getEmployeeById and policyService.getAllPolicies() as the cross-module read surface (no new repository/service methods).
Follow the createLeaveService-style factory pattern for wiring the concrete service in the route (resolve from fastify instance if present, else construct).

integrationPoints.why: Resolve the employee to obtain hireDate (the accrual anchor) and to surface NotFoundError for an unknown employee.
Enumerate policies to derive which leave types have a current period and to select the effective policy per leaveTypeCode.
Compute the current accrual period for each policy anchored on hireDate.
The route's actor is resolved from the verified token; the endpoint requires a valid bearer token.
